artworks.title: The Angel Gives Saint John the Book to Eat
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 29.9 × 21.6 cm (11 3/4 × 8 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with a figure holding a book, an angel, clouds, and architectural features. The central figure is kneeling with a book of blank pages. An angelic being is above the figure amidst swirling clouds. The scene includes intricate details such as architectural elements, foliage, ships near a fortified city, and detailed clouds blending with the wings and drapery of the angel. The style of the drawing suggests careful engraving techniques with lines and shading providing depth and volume.

artworks.title: The Beast with Seven Heads and Ten Horns
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a scene with a multi-headed beast and surrounding figures. The central focus is a creature with the body of a lion and multiple serpentine necks extending into different animal heads. Each head displays features reminiscent of mythical animals. Surrounding the beast are several figures, some gesturing towards it. The drawing is highly detailed with intricate line work, resembling Renaissance-style engravings. There are heavenly elements like clouds and potentially angelic figures or celestial symbols at the top. The scene conveys drama and chaos, typical of apocalyptic or fantastical themes.

artworks.title: The Dragon and the Beast
artworks.dimensions: sheet ([irreg.] trimmed to plate mark): 30.1 × 21.6 cm (11 7/8 × 8 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a complex and dynamic scene rich in mythical imagery. The composition features an array of figures, both human and fantastical, interacting in a densely packed and intricately detailed environment. Celestial beings are shown descending from the clouds at the top of the image while various figures dressed in elaborate Renaissance-style attire gather around and engage with each other below. A large lion stands next to a dragon or beast-like creature in the lower right quadrant. Grand architectural structures are visible in the background, adding depth to the scene. The drawing is framed by an arched top, and the style resembles high Renaissance engravings with fine lines and meticulous attention to detail.

artworks.title: The Opening of the Seventh Seal
artworks.dimensions: sheet ([irreg.] trimmed to plate mark): 30.5 × 22.2 cm (12 × 8 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythological or biblical scene with numerous figures in dynamic poses. The composition is intricate and densely packed, with figures floating or ascending amidst clouds. A regal figure is seated on a throne at the top, surrounded by other celestial beings. Below, there is a chaotic scene with figures in various states of action and turmoil. Some are playing trumpets. In the background are architectural structures or cities, adding depth to the image. The artwork depicts muscular forms and elaborate drapery, reminiscent of the Renaissance or late Gothic periods. The contrast between divine figures above and the tumultuous scene below implies a narrative of judgement or divine intervention.

artworks.title: The Cumaean Sibyl
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 20.2 × 13.7 cm (7 15/16 × 5 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a seated woman holding a scroll, looking upward. She is surrounded by cherubic figures and an angel. The scene is set in an architectural backdrop with columns and arches, showcasing a cityscape in the background. A large urn-like object with an engraved name is on the floor beside her.

artworks.title: The Winepress of the Wrath of God
artworks.dimensions: sheet ([irreg.] trimmed within plate mark): 31 × 22.1 cm (12 3/16 × 8 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a black and white engraving showing a group of angelic figures surrounding a central celestial presence. The detailed composition features intricate linework. A dominant figure with a halo and flowing robes is seen at the top, engaging with the surrounding angelic beings. These figures are depicted in detailed garments and wings, playing a part in a mysterious scene. Below, there is a fortified cityscape with towers and gates, suggesting a historical or mythical setting. The artwork portrays a significant event, possibly celestial or mythological, with densely packed figures and architectural elements demonstrating perspective and depth, giving the composition a dynamic quality.

artworks.title: Design for the Chimney Piece in the Throne Room, Buckingham Palace
artworks.description: This is a detailed drawing of a decorative fireplace mantel design. It features intricate decorative elements on the left side and along the mantelpiece. The left vertical panel displays elegant motifs, including floral and shield emblems arranged vertically. At the top of the mantel, there are two reclining figures facing each other with a central crown element surrounded by garlands. The right panel is depicted with simple rectangular outlines suggesting a door-like feature. The drawing shows precision in architectural detailing, with measurements noted around the design elements.

artworks.title: Group of Female Figures
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several figures gathered together. The full-description reveals a faint sketch in pencil, featuring a group of figures in various poses. Some figures are standing close together, while one figure is kneeling. The sketches depict a loose and fluid style, with gentle and subtle lines illustrating flowing forms and delicate postures. The left side of the drawing contains additional faint lines and abstract shapes.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.description: The image is a portrait drawing of a person. The subject appears facing slightly to the left, with curly hair styled upwards. The facial features include a prominent nose and expressive eyes. The subject is depicted wearing period-style attire with a high-collared jacket and possible cravat or necktie. The background is plain, solely focused on the subject's profile.

artworks.title: Sheet of Sketches [recto and verso]
artworks.description: The image shows light pencil sketches on a plain paper. The sketches feature human figures in different poses, often in pairs or small groups. The figures are outlined with minimal facial details and flowing hair. They are depicted in robes or garments with lightly sketched folds. In the background, there are faint architectural elements like columns and pediments. The scenes are spread across the page, creating a rough composition of interconnected vignettes.

artworks.title: Patron Saints of Bologna
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 25.5 x 23.1 cm (10 1/16 x 9 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image features a group of individuals lined up and interacting. From left to right: an older male figure in bishop attire holding a crook and an architectural model, a woman with a halo holding a framed medallion, a young man with long hair and a halo holding a staff, and another figure behind him holding a staff. The background includes clouds, sun rays, and a celestial figure.

artworks.title: Manao Tupapau (She is Haunted by a Spirit)
artworks.description: The image shows a person lying on their stomach on a bed, with long dark hair flowing back. The person's face has a calm expression, eyes looking towards the viewer. Their unclothed body is in a reclining pose on the bed, with arms bent at the elbows. Decorative patterns with flower motifs are on the bedding. In the background, there are abstract shapes and three statue-like figures. The environment has a mix of light and dark shading. The image is signed by the creator, Paul Gauguin.

artworks.title: The Rider
artworks.medium: gouache monotype touched with gum or varnish on laid paper
artworks.description: In this abstract composition, soft lines and blurred edges converge to form shapes that suggest familiar figures. The curving outlines at the center resemble a person riding an animal and another animal figure beside them. The background dissolves into a blend of colors that evoke a natural landscape setting, with areas that could be interpreted as trees or foliage. On the left side, spiraling shapes bear a resemblance to floral elements.

artworks.title: Shepherd with Four Goats (Les quatre chèvres)
artworks.description: The image is viewed from a slightly elevated perspective, allowing a view down onto a pastoral scene. In the distance, the horizon is obscured by a dense collection of trees and foliage that occupies the upper half of the image. The brushstrokes or etching lines in the piece are intricate and fine, with a detailed cross-hatching technique creating a sense of depth and texture throughout the scene. The color palette is monochromatic, consisting of varying shades of black and sepia on a light beige background. Close to us, a group of goats stands in a clearing, with a seated figure partially concealed amidst the foliage. The overall composition emphasizes the natural texture and patterns of the landscape and the animals within it.

artworks.title: Two Dapple-Gray Horses Exercising (Deux chevaux gris pommele que l'on promene)
artworks.description: The image shows a man sitting upright on a horse, with another horse beside him. The man has short, light-colored hair and is wearing a cap, a red jacket, white riding pants, and black boots. Both horses are fitted with a yellow and white checked textile covering. The background consists of a muted blue and beige sky, with the ground depicted in earthy tones.

artworks.title: Bull Attacked by Dogs
artworks.description: The image shows a bull surrounded by several dogs. One dog appears airborne near the bull, while others are around it. The bull has an injury on its back. In the background, two figures are watching the scene. The drawing portrays a dynamic and dramatic interaction between the animals with expressive lines conveying movement and tension.

artworks.title: Dans un parc
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed and intricate etching depicting a view from eye-level. In the distance, an ancient or medieval stone archway can be seen partially hidden by dense foliage. The horizon is suggested by the meeting point of trees and architectural elements against the sky. The artwork uses a limited color palette of sepia and black, emphasizing texture through fine lines. The foreground consists of lush vegetation, including trees with bare branches creating a natural frame around the scene across the archway.

artworks.title: Interior of a Military Chamber
artworks.description: This is an illustration of a military barracks interior scene. The room is filled with various activities and items. Rifles are lined against the wall to the left, and shelves hold pots, bottles, and bags. Characters are involved in different actions, contributing to a busy atmosphere. In the center, figures are around a person in bed, while others are examining materials or grooming. The drawing portrays the camaraderie and daily life in a communal living space, offering a glimpse into military life. The shading and detailing add depth to the illustration.

artworks.title: Title Page
artworks.description: The image features a detailed baroque-style frame surrounding a text. An ornate collection of musical instruments and tools are integrated into the top and bottom of the frame. The color palette consists of various shades of brown, giving an antique feel. The central text is flanked by elaborate garlands featuring instruments like a violin, a lute, and tools at the upper corners. The lower part of the image shows a pastoral scene with people and a building, providing a balanced layout.

artworks.title: Le dragon qui se void dans le jardin de Ruel
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate decoration and garden scene. The upper section of the drawing features an intricate arrangement of gemstones or jewels, depicted with a high level of detail, showcasing faceted surfaces and round, polished beads. This collection of jewels is surrounded by a wreath of leaves and ribbons. Below the jewel arrangement, there is a landscape view of a garden. In this section, there is a fountain at the center, surrounded by trees and pathways. The garden scene seems to represent a formal garden layout typical of grand estates, characterized by neatly arranged trees and a symmetrically structured water feature. The structure of this scene suggests a depiction of elegance and wealth.

artworks.title: Fontaines qui se voyent a Ruel
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three ornate pendants surrounded by a floral border with a landscape scene below. The central image features three intricately designed pendants, each hanging from ribbons and set within a lavish arrangement of flowers. The top pendant is shaped like a flower, the pendant on the right has a circular design, and the bottom pendant resembles a clock face with Roman numerals. Surrounding the pendants is a border of various flowers. Below this image is a scene of a garden with fountains, trees, pathways, and tiny human figures.

artworks.title: Rome
artworks.description: The image has two sections. The upper section features ornamental designs with floral arrangements, ribbons, and birds. The lower section shows a cityscape labeled "Rome" with iconic architectural features. The color palette is monochromatic with various shades of brown and beige.

artworks.title: Saint Denis en France
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a decorative arrangement with architectural and floral motifs. The central feature is an elaborate depiction of large, symmetrical bows and ornaments, surrounded by intricate floral and leafy designs. At the top center of the arrangement, an anthropomorphic face is visible, flanked by stylized floral patterns on each side. Below the decorative arrangement, there is a smaller, detailed landscape scene labeled "Sainct Denis en France," showing a cityscape with a prominent church or cathedral structure. The entire composition is meticulously detailed, showcasing a high level of craftsmanship in its depiction of both the ornate decorations and the architectural elements.

artworks.title: Paris
artworks.description: The image is an etching featuring an ornate design at the top with intricate frames and floral motifs. The frames are suspended within a circular floral wreath. The etching technique provides detailed textures and patterns. Below this is a cityscape labeled "PARIS" with a ribbon banner. The skyline shows spires, rooftops, and small figures typical of a city setting in a monochromatic color palette.
